# don Quijote

> > Spanish language schools offering immersion programs across Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Salamanca, Seville) and Latin America (Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica) with specialized courses and cultural education.

don Quijote provides comprehensive Spanish language education through immersion programs in over a dozen locations across Spain and Latin America. The site features language courses for all ages, specialized programs including gap years and internships, and cultural content exploring Spanish language, traditions, and expressions.

## Key Topics

- Spanish immersion programs
- Study abroad in Spain and Latin America
- Intensive Spanish courses
- Spanish language learning
- Cultural immersion
- Teen summer camps
- Gap year programs
- Spanish schools in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia
- Latin American destinations: Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica
- Spanish expressions and idioms
- Practical Spanish
- Language internships
- Spanish grammar and vocabulary
- Spanish cultural traditions
- Anglicisms in Spanish

## Spanish Language Schools & Programs

- [Spanish language schools in Spain. Spanish courses in Spain.](https://www.donquijote.org/learn-spanish-spain): Spanish language schools and courses across Spain destinations
- [Learn Spanish in Mexico - Spanish immersion schools in Mexico](https://www.donquijote.org/learn-spanish-latin-america/mexico): Spanish language schools and cultural immersion in Mexico
- [Learn Spanish in Colombia - Spanish schools in Colombia](https://www.donquijote.org/learn-spanish-latin-america/colombia): Spanish language schools and immersion courses in Colombia
- [Learn Spanish in Costa Rica - Spanish schools in Costa Rica](https://www.donquijote.org/learn-spanish-latin-america/costa-rica): Spanish language schools and immersion programs in Costa Rica

## Specialized Programs

- [Learn Spanish in a Gap Year Abroad in Spain or Latin America](https://www.donquijote.org/specialized-spanish-courses/gap-year-program): Gap year Spanish immersion program in Spain and Latin America
- [Internship Program in Spain or Latin America](https://www.donquijote.org/specialized-spanish-courses/internship): Spanish internship program combining language and work experience
- [Spanish program for teenagers in Salamanca 14-21 years](https://www.donquijote.org/teenagers/salamanca): Teen Spanish immersion program in Salamanca with activities
- [All-inclusive Spanish program in Spain for teenagers ages 14-21](https://www.donquijote.org/teenagers/valencia): Teen Spanish immersion program in Valencia with accommodation

## Spanish Language Learning

- [Poco, bastante, mucho and demasiado: Spanish quantifiers](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/spanish-quantifiers-poco-bastante-mucho-and-demasiado): Spanish quantifiers grammar tutorial: poco, bastante, mucho, demasiado
- [Varieties of the Spanish language | donQuijote](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/varieties-of-the-spanish-language): Lesser-known Spanish varieties: Equatorial Guinea, Ladino, dialects
- [10 Spanish Words Borrowed From English | DonQuijote](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/10-spanish-words-borrowed-from-english): Anglicisms and English loanwords in Spanish vocabulary
- [The Royal Academy of Spanish vs Anglicisms | donQuijote](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/the-royal-academy-of-spanish-declares-war-on-anglicisms): Royal Academy's campaign against anglicisms in Spanish language

## Spanish Expressions & Idioms

- [Cats: Multiple Lives. Infinite Expressions | donQuijote](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/cats-multiple-lives-infinite-expressions): Spanish cat-related idioms and expressions explained
- [Bundle up or you'll turn into a bird](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/bundle-up-or-you-ll-turn-into-a-bird): Spanish bird-related idioms and figurative expressions

## Spanish Culture & Traditions

- [Spanish cooking in wintertime | donQuijote](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/spanish-recipes-for-winter): Traditional Spanish winter recipes and comfort food dishes
- [How to host a Spanish Dinner Party: Paella](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/the-simplest-spanish-paella-recipe): Valencian paella recipe and Spanish dinner party guide
- [Most Famous New Year's Tradition in Spain](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/spain-s-most-famous-new-year-s-tradition): Spain's 12 grapes New Year's Eve tradition at Puerta del Sol Madrid
- [Kings of Spain named Felipe | donQuijote](https://www.donquijote.org/blog/felipe-kings-of-spain): Overview of Spain's six Felipe monarchs and Habsburg dynasty
